1. Oversee the implementation of all QC testing activities, including water quality, microbiology, Fry Health Monitoring (FHM), nauplii, algae, Artemia, polychaete, and PCR testing, ensuring compliance with established SOPs and testing schedules.

2. Analyze quality and production performance data, including shrimp postlarvae performance, while managing QC databases and utilizing analytical insights to drive continuous quality improvement.

3. Ensure effective QC operations through supervision of equipment maintenance and calibration, inventory management, customer complaint analysis, and implementation of corrective and preventive actions.

4. Support quality assurance and compliance initiatives by participating in certifications, audits, inspections, and collaborations with internal and external stakeholders to enhance QC analytical processes.

5. Lead and develop the QC team through coaching, performance evaluation, competency development, and by fostering a collaborative culture focused on continuous improvement, 5S, and Occupational Health and Safety (OHS).

Qualifications:

• Minimum Bachelor's Degree (S1/D4) in Fisheries, Biology, Veterinary Medicine, or a related field.
• Minimum 3-5 years of experience in Quality Control (QC), Quality Assurance (QA), Laboratory Operations, or the Aquaculture/Shrimp Hatchery Industry; prior team leadership experience is an advantage.
• Strong knowledge of laboratory testing and analysis, including water quality, microbiology, PCR, Fry Health Monitoring (FHM), algae culture, Artemia, and shrimp fry/postlarvae quality parameters.
• Familiar with quality management and compliance systems, including SOP implementation, audits, certifications, equipment calibration, Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), biosecurity, Occupational Health & Safety (OHS), and 5S practices.
• Strong analytical and leadership skills, with the ability to manage QC data, solve problems, evaluate quality performance, develop team capabilities, and collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
• Willing to be based in Sumbawa.

1. Mengawasi pelaksanaan dan kualitas seluruh pengujian QC meliputi kualitas air, mikrobiologi, FHM, nauplii, alga, Artemia, polychaete, PCR, serta memastikan analisis dilakukan sesuai SOP dan jadwal yang berlaku.

2. Menganalisis data dan kinerja kualitas produksi, termasuk evaluasi performa postlarva udang, pengelolaan database QC, serta penyusunan dan pemanfaatan data untuk peningkatan kualitas berkelanjutan.

3. Memastikan efektivitas operasional QC melalui pengawasan kalibrasi dan perawatan alat, pengelolaan stok, penanganan keluhan pelanggan, serta penerapan tindakan korektif dan preventif.

4. Mendukung kepatuhan dan standar mutu perusahaan dengan berpartisipasi dalam proses sertifikasi, audit, inspeksi, serta berkolaborasi dengan pihak internal dan eksternal terkait pengembangan parameter analisis QC.

5. Memimpin dan mengembangkan tim QC melalui coaching, evaluasi kinerja, peningkatan kompetensi, serta memastikan penerapan budaya kerja kolaboratif, continuous improvement, 5S, dan K3 di seluruh area kerja.

Kualifikasi

• Minimal Sarjana (S1/D4) di bidang Perikanan, Biologi, Kedokteran Hewan;
• Memiliki pengalaman minimal 3-5 tahun di bidang Quality Control (QC), Quality Assurance (QA), Laboratorium, atau Industri Akuakultur/Hatchery Udang, dengan pengalaman memimpin tim menjadi nilai tambah;
• Menguasai pengujian dan analisis laboratorium, termasuk kualitas air, mikrobiologi, PCR, Fry Health Monitoring (FHM), kultur alga, Artemia, serta parameter kualitas benur/postlarva udang;
• Memahami sistem manajemen mutu dan kepatuhan, seperti SOP, audit, sertifikasi, kalibrasi alat, CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action), biosecurity, serta penerapan K3 dan 5S.
• Memiliki kemampuan analitis dan kepemimpinan yang baik, mampu mengelola data QC, menyelesaikan masalah, melakukan evaluasi kualitas, membimbing tim, serta berkolaborasi dengan berbagai pemangku kepentingan internal maupun eksternal;
• Bersedia ditempatkan di Sumbawa

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh.
